finding: The selected SBS source dates the reported KODEX200 unit price and 80.76% year-to-date return to September 20, 2026 and explicitly says the comparison ran through September 20. The KRX calendar has no session on that Sunday. The draft repeats the figure as a September 20 period return without highlighting that the price date cannot be a KRX trading close.
potential_resolution: Obtain a separate point-in-time fund price and calculation date; otherwise omit the precise return or explicitly warn that the source's date cannot be verified as a trading-session price.
quality_implication: A source-backed quote is not enough to certify a market number when the source's claimed trading date conflicts with the exchange calendar. Model reviewer marked numbers and timing true; the independent audit must overrule that false positive if the final post retains the unqualified figure.
